prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Samsung MiniDV Digital Camcorder - SCDC382; brand: samsung; description: Samsung MiniDV Digital Camcorder - SCDC382/ 680K Pixel CCD/ 34X Zoom Lens/ 720 x 480 Pixel Movie Resolution/ Digital Image Stabilizer/ 23 Language Options/ 80 Minute Battery Life

Candidates:
1. name: Samsung SC-D382 Digital Camcorder; brand: Samsung; description: Samsung SC-D382 Mini DV Camcorder; price: $128.96; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
2. name: Samsung NV30 Digital Camera - Silver - EC-NV30ZSBA/US; brand: Samsung; description: Samsung NV30 8 Megapixel Digital Camera with Schneider Lens, Dual Image Stabilization, Smart Touch, and Face Detection - Silver; price: $139.00; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
3. name: Samsung L200 Digital Camera - Black - EC-L200ZBBA/US; brand: Samsung; description: Samsung L200 10 Megapixel Digital Camera with 2.5 LCD, 3x Optical Zoom, Digital Image Stabilization, Face Detection Function - Black; price: $119.00; check: model numbers differ, brand equal

response.text: {"reason": "The model number SCDC382 in the price-list item matches SC-D382 in candidate 1, ignoring case and spaces.", "choice": 1, "confidence": 0.9}
